policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: Burkina Faso visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Singapore MFA says Singaporeans may stay in Burkina Faso for up to 30 days without a visa.
conditions: The named ordinary Singapore-passport short-visit waiver is limited to 30 days.
Yellow-fever, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
